svg.text: Note: Parallel requires all filters to agree — any REJECT blocks
the pipeline. Injection check may need to run before PII for accuracy.
Input pipeline: 38ms seq / 15ms par | Output pipeline: 50ms seq / 20ms par
Allow + log for human review / SIEM
Return canned safe response to user
Confidence threshold: output score < 0.7 → FLAG | < 0.4 → REJECT
PII in output → always SANITIZE before delivery
